title: Idle Hands
controls_hint: Tap the game canvas to begin
about: A touch-first cabinet of eight classic games for phone, tablet, and desktop: Solitaire, FreeCell, Sudoku, Minesweeper, 2048, Nonogram, Yahtzee, and Reversi.
Phase 0 defines the collection. The playable cabinet and first game arrive in Phase 1.

controls.desc: Choose cabinet objects, controls, cards, cells, dice, and discs
Move cards, mark puzzle cells, and slide tiles
Provide an alternative to every gesture
